name: S26 boundOf: the bound is not rounded down
why: EQUIVALENT: both bounds are compared with whole numbers (a count of entries, a sum of lengths), and x > 2.9, x >= 3 and x > 2 agree for every whole x, as do x <= 2.9 and x <= 2

name: S27 boundOf: a non-number is not rejected by `typeof`
why: EQUIVALENT: Number.isFinite answers false for a string, an object and undefined without coercing, so the typeof test repeats it

name: S28 createWorkspaceSymbolCache: the text is compared first (the cheap two last)

why: EQUIVALENT in every answer; only the cost differs (a file whose mode changed is compared character by character before it is found different), and no count or clock row of a unit test can see it at the sizes it runs
